headline: Tarawneh: Jordanian to lead global pulmonology body, kingdom to host World Congress
dek: The Jordan News Agency reported that Jordan's Tarawneh will lead a global pulmonology body and that the kingdom will host a World Congress.
body:
Jordan's Tarawneh is to lead a global pulmonology body, according to a report from the Jordan News Agency published on 14 November 2026. The report's headline also states that the kingdom will host a World Congress.

The item available to LungDaily contained only its headline. It did not give Tarawneh's full name or the name of the organisation. It also did not state the date or location of the congress, so those details are not reported here.

source.title: Jordan's Tarawneh to Lead Global Pulmonology Body; Kingdom to Host World Congress
